name: JAC Japan map scale 20 km, 22 players, 50 turns

steps.code: local w,h=Map.GetGridSize(); if w~=154 or h~=67 then error('map grid mismatch '..w..'x'..h) end; local minors=0; for _,m in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMinors()) do if PlayerConfigurations[m:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName()~='CIVILIZATION_FREE_CITIES' then minors=minors+1 end end; if minors~=0 then error('city-states present: '..minors) end; if #PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()~=22 then error('major count') end; local expected={{90,31,2},{111,32,4},{109,30,2},{97,23,3},{101,28,5},{97,27,2},{102,35,1},{94,24,3},{90,29,1},{91,37,1},{86,34,12},{78,35,4},{87,33,2},{84,34,1},{69,47,3},{80,46,1},{75,45,1},{73,36,1},{65,43,1},{56,40,3},{24,30,2},{135,47,1}}; local leaders={'LEADER_JAC_ODA_NOBUHIDE','LEADER_JAC_DATE_TANEMUNE','LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO','LEADER_JAC_HOJO_UJITSUNA','LEADER_JAC_YAMANOUCHI_UESUGI_NORIMASA','LEADER_JAC_TAKEDA_NOBUTORA','LEADER_JAC_NAGAO_TAMEKAGE','LEADER_JAC_IMAGAWA_UJITERU','LEADER_JAC_MATSUDAIRA_KIYOYASU','LEADER_JAC_ASAKURA_TAKAKAGE','LEADER_JAC_ASHIKAGA_YOSHIHARU','LEADER_JAC_MIYOSHI_NAGAYOSHI','LEADER_JAC_ROKKAKU_SADAYORI','LEADER_JAC_HONGANJI_SHONYO','LEADER_JAC_OUCHI_YOSHITAKA','LEADER_JAC_AMAGO_TSUNEHISA','LEADER_JAC_MORI_MOTONARI','LEADER_JAC_CHOSOKABE_KUNICHIKA','LEADER_JAC_OTOMO_YOSHIAKI','LEADER_JAC_SHIMAZU_TAKAHISA','LEADER_JAC_RYUKYU_SHO_SEI','LEADER_JAC_AINU_TARIKONA'}; local civs={'CIVILIZATION_JAC_ODA','CIVILIZATION_JAC_DATE','CIVILIZATION_JAC_ASHINA','CIVILIZATION_JAC_HOJO','CIVILIZATION_JAC_YAMANOUCHI_UESUGI','CIVILIZATION_JAC_TAKEDA','CIVILIZATION_JAC_NAGAO','CIVILIZATION_JAC_IMAGAWA','CIVILIZATION_JAC_MATSUDAIRA','CIVILIZATION_JAC_ASAKURA','CIVILIZATION_JAC_ASHIKAGA','CIVILIZATION_JAC_MIYOSHI','CIVILIZATION_JAC_ROKKAKU','CIVILIZATION_JAC_HONGANJI','CIVILIZATION_JAC_OUCHI','CIVILIZATION_JAC_AMAGO','CIVILIZATION_JAC_MORI','CIVILIZATION_JAC_CHOSOKABE','CIVILIZATION_JAC_OTOMO','CIVILIZATION_JAC_SHIMAZU','CIVILIZATION_JAC_RYUKYU','CIVILIZATION_JAC_AINU'}; for i=0,21 do local p=Players[i]; if not p or not p:IsAlive() then error('missing player '..i) end; if PlayerConfigurations[i]:GetLeaderTypeName()~=leaders[i+1] or PlayerConfigurations[i]:GetCivilizationTypeName()~=civs[i+1] then error('faction mismatch '..i) end; local e=expected[i+1]; if p:GetCities():GetCount()~=e[3] then error('city count '..i..'='..p:GetCities():GetCount()..' expected '..e[3]) end; local capital=p:GetCities():GetCapitalCity(); if not capital or capital:GetX()~=e[1] or capital:GetY()~=e[2] then error('capital mismatch '..i) end end; local land=0; for index=0,w*h-1 do local tile=Map.GetPlotByIndex(index); if tile and not tile:IsWater() then land=land+1; if tile:GetOwner()<0 then error('unowned land plot '..index) end end end; if land~=1082 then error('land tile count '..land) end; for i=0,21 do local p=Players[i]; if p then for _,unit in p:GetUnits():Members() do if GameInfo.Units[unit:GetUnitType()].UnitType=='UNIT_SETTLER' then error('settler in slot '..i) end end end end; return '22 majors, 0 city-states, expected cities/capitals, all land owned, no settlers'

local w,h=Map.GetGridSize(); if w~=154 or h~=67 then error('map grid mismatch '..w..'x'..h) end; local minors=0; for _,m in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMinors()) do if PlayerConfigurations[m:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName()~='CIVILIZATION_FREE_CITIES' then minors=minors+1 end end; if minors~=0 then error('city-states present: '..minors) end; local land=0; for index=0,w*h-1 do local tile=Map.GetPlotByIndex(index); if tile and not tile:IsWater() then land=land+1; if tile:GetOwner()<0 then error('unowned land plot '..index) end end end; if land~=1082 then error('land tile count '..land) end; for i=0,21 do local p=Players[i]; if p then for _,unit in p:GetUnits():Members() do if GameInfo.Units[unit:GetUnitType()].UnitType=='UNIT_SETTLER' then error('settler in slot '..i) end end end end; if Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()<51 or not Players[0]:IsAlive() then error('50-turn state lost') end; local values={tostring(#PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors())}; for i=0,21 do local p=Players[i]; values[#values+1]=tostring(p:GetCities():GetCount()); values[#values+1]=tostring(p:IsAlive()) end; local hash=0; for index=0,w*h-1 do local tile=Map.GetPlotByIndex(index); if tile and not tile:IsWater() then hash=(hash*131+tile:GetOwner()+1)%2147483647 end end; values[#values+1]=tostring(hash); return table.concat(values, ',')
